method.schedule: model order fixed; worker/arm blocks reversed on odd repetitions; one process at a time
method.cpu_s: sum of GNU time user and sys seconds
method.rss: GNU time maximum resident set size in bytes; median of per-run peaks
method.ratios: median within-repetition TLC/reference wall divided by core wall; values above 1 favor core; scaling also pairs repetitions and requires actual worker use
method.rss_ratios: ratio of medians of per-run peak RSS
